_h5_doc: voanews.com: path_regex limits reads to /a/<slug>/<id>.html (never /z/, /tv/, /radio/, /embed/, /comments/); require_any_markers = a positive VOA byline must appear in the page text; wire_markers = any hit makes it link only; staff bylines other than By VOA News stay link-only until added here. en.wikinews.org is closed and read-only since about 2026-05-04 (summary-grade): an archive that provides no current news, still valid evidence; /wiki/ mainspace only, enforced by an allowlist path_regex that excludes any colon, percent sign or question mark (so Special:, Talk:, Category:, Template:, User_talk:, encoded namespaces and query strings all fail). OD-1106-HITL H5 (a), 2026-11-06: voanews.com allow limited to VOA-original items (optional per-outlet path_prefixes = URL path allowlist; wire_markers = a fetched page containing any marker is dropped, link only); AP, Reuters, NPR, PBS link-only; propublica.org and theconversation.com exclude; Global Voices and Wikinews unchanged (allow).
_outlets_doc: Outlet pages linked from GDELT are read ONLY for a host listed here with terms_verdict "allow" and a terms_evidence pointer, and only where robots.txt and page signals permit (vera/public_fetch.py, vera/source_permissions.py). links_only rows and unlisted hosts (unlisted_verdict) are never read; exclude rows are dropped. Match is the exact host or a subdomain.
_wiki_link_drop_doc: NT-3 / security review NEWS2: Wikipedia-citation links keep the cited external pages only; any URL on these hosts (or a subdomain) is dropped, never shown as Reported news.
_emit_doc: W2 and W6 are in place (lane_evidence honours read_ok=False; redirect hops are gated). SEC-RR R1 is in place (INTEGRATE-1104: lane_evidence reads only items tagged read_ok is True and _reporting_hop always requires an allow outlet on the start host). OWNER DECISION 2026-11-05 (verbatim): "News sources: yes, as far as permitted by each source's permissions and license terms." Applied (PERF-MISS-1105-FIX2): emit_link_only true and outlet_query "all". Every outlet is searched; only allow outlets (terms_verdict allow with terms_evidence) are read in full, with robots.txt and the allow-outlet hop check on every hop; links_only and unlisted outlets (deny-all: unknown terms) are title + link only, never fetched or quoted; exclude outlets are dropped (none listed: work/NEWS-LANE-1104/compliance.md records no outlet whose terms forbid linking or title display). The GDELT credit is shown whenever GDELT answered.
_calibration_note: min_interval_s 6: GDELT's own 429 body (observed 2026-11-03, work/NONASK-1103/news-portals-evidence.md) asks for one request every 5 seconds; 1 s margin. crawl_delay_s 10 is globalvoices.org's robots.txt Crawl-delay (2026-11-04). news_intent.recent_years_back 1: a named year counts as current-events only for this year or last year; measured on the two RCA questions (work/PERF-MISS-1104/rca.md) and the offline cases in tests/test_news_lane_1104_intent.py, not on production traffic; widen if recent-past questions are missed, narrow if historical questions are routed to news.
